passage:
**Budget of a town by sector, 2024 and 2025** (in millions of pesos)

| Sector | 2024 | 2025 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Education | 40 | 45 |
| Health | 25 | 30 |
| Roads and bridges | 50 | 60 |
| Agriculture | 20 | 15 |
| Social welfare | 25 | 50 |
stem: Which sector had the second largest budget in 2024?
hints: The table has two years. Use only the 2024 column.
Read down the 2024 column and find the largest number first.
Set the largest number aside. The biggest number left is the second largest. Read across to its sector name.

solution.methodName: Read the title and units, then find the row and column

steps.action: Find the 2024 column. Its numbers are 40, 25, 50, 20 and 25.
steps.why: The question asks about 2024, so leave out the 2025 column.

steps.action: The largest is 50, for Roads and bridges.
Set 50 aside. The largest number left is 40.
steps.why: The second largest is the biggest number after the largest one.

steps.action: Read across the row with 40: it is Education. Education had the second largest budget in 2024.

trapNotes.Health: Health is in the second row of the table, but the question asks for the second largest budget, not the second row. Health had only ₱25 million in 2024.
trapNotes.Social welfare: Social welfare is the second largest in 2025 (₱50 million). In 2024 it had only ₱25 million. Use the 2024 column.
trapNotes.Roads and bridges: Roads and bridges had the largest budget in 2024 (₱50 million), not the second largest.
